response.sql: SELECT c.zoneref AS site_reference, s.insurstat AS insurance_status, COUNT(*) AS record_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS fraction FROM scanconservation c INNER JOIN sites s ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY c.zoneref, s.insurstat ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST, c.zoneref, s.insurstat LIMIT 10
